info.title: GetBrandByPages
info.description: Use this API to retrieve all product brands by page index in the system.

get.description: Use this API to retrieve all product brands by page index in the system.

global_identifier.description: A unique string identifier for the brand across different systems. For example: ADIDAS, NIKE, APPLE.

name_en.description: The English name of the brand.

name.description: The actual name of the brand.

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: app_key
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Unique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: timestamp
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: startRow
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Number of brands to skip (i.e., an offset into the result set; together with the "limit" parameter, simple result set paging is possible; if you do page through results, note that the list of brands might change during paging).

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: pageSize
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: The maximum number of brands that can be returned. If you omit this parameter, the default of 40 is used. The Maximum is 200.
